plan.title: SHG Loan Register Overview
plan.subtitle: Details on loan repayment status and purpose.

panels.title: Total Loans Disbursed
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM shg_loan_register

panels.title: Loan Repayment Status
panels.sql: SELECT 'Closed' AS RepaymentStatus, COUNT(*) AS count FROM shg_loan_register WHERE Repayment Status = 'Closed' UNION ALL SELECT 'Overdue' AS RepaymentStatus, COUNT(*) AS count FROM shg_loan_register WHERE Repayment Status = 'Overdue' UNION ALL SELECT 'Regular' AS RepaymentStatus, COUNT(*) AS count FROM shg_loan_register WHERE Repayment Status = 'Regular' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Loan Purpose
panels.sql: SELECT Purpose, COUNT(*) AS count FROM shg_loan_register GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 8

panels.title: Loan Amount Distribution
panels.sql: SELECT Purpose, AVG(Loan Amount (Rs)) AS avg_amount FROM shg_loan_register GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
